name: A busy half hour keeps Boop lively without flailing
case: A realistic half hour: a few quick turns, a failing build the agent fixes, a twelve-minute turn of quiet work that finishes well, and a couple more quick turns. Boop is clearly alive the whole time: it reacts often, never leaves a turn on the plain working look for more than about six minutes, and reacts to most finishes, not just the notable ones. Its mood moves a few times (annoyed at the failure, on at the fix, excited or proud at the long finish, back toward calm in between) without bouncing back and forth.
why: The owner's liveliness brief (2026-09-28): an animated buddy, a repetition penalty, no long idles, and progressive moods, together over ordinary work
